newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian women jailed over 30-second rape.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian women jailed over 30-second rape.

text.p: Two Australian women were sentenced to jail on Monday for conspiring to pervert the course of justice over a 30-second rape which saw a man sentenced to four years' prison.
Kevin Ibbs, 44, was jailed in 1987 after he was convicted of failing to stop having sex with his former lover, Christine Watson, 30 seconds after she withdrew her consent.
Ibbs, dubbed the "30-second rapist" by media, spent seven months in prison before being released after appealing to have his sentence reduced.

The Western Australia District Court in Perth sentenced Watson, 35, and Ibbs' former wife Katrina Carter, 38, to 18 months and two years in jail respectively for conspiracy after planning to accuse Ibbs of rape.
Watson was a friend of Carter's invited by her to stay with the couple as long as she had sex with Ibbs.

The two women pleaded guilty to conspiracy but the court accepted that the conspiracy was never carried out and did not rule that the original rape sentence was wrong. Ibbs is still fighting to have the 1987 verdict overturned.
